LPPSA Refinance Application Summary

This document outlines a proposed LPPSA (Lembaga Pembiayaan Perumahan Sektor Awam)
refinance package for a residential property in Kuala Lumpur.

Loan amount: RM 420,000
Tenure: 25 years
Estimated monthly instalment: RM 2,180 (subject to final approval)

The borrower intends to refinance an existing LPPSA housing loan to obtain a lower
fixed interest rate. Key eligibility criteria include remaining service of at least
five years and a clean repayment record for the past twelve months.

Supporting documents attached: latest LPPSA statement, payslip, and property
valuation report dated March 2026.
